name: AI Disaster Response ML Model Exploration & UI Upgrade

description: baseline: project audit — XGBoost pipeline, synthetic data, no uncertainty, no geospatial modeling, Nepal-only demo

CCGA: conformal-calibrated generative augmentation — VAE augmentation + conformal filtering for imbalanced tabular flood risk. Experiment failed: -1.71% F1 vs baseline. Augmentation hurt performance on balanced data. Conformal filtering worked (92% coverage).

Model comparison: XGBoost, RF, ET, GB, MLP. XGBoost wins on efficiency (0.76ms, 1.6MB). RF wins on F1 (0.7872). Conformal prediction achieves 90%+ coverage on all models. Tabular DL (MLP) underperforms tree ensembles — consistent with Grinsztajn et al. 2022.

Split conformal prediction for flood risk classification: XGBoost+standard achieves 89.25% actual coverage (target 90%, gap=0.007). At 95%: 95.25%. ACI unstable (collapses at alpha=0.20). Distribution shift: standard conformal undercovers at alpha=0.10 (83% vs 90%) but maintains at alpha=0.05 (93.9% vs 95%). Prediction sets avg size 0.89 (most single-label).
